Class LostRule

java.lang.Object
dev.swordai.core.rl.LostRule
public final class LostRule extends Object
When the opponent has gone off the screen, the camera is not left to the network: it turns, at the hand's full speed, to the side the opponent was last seen on, and comes level (an opponent on the same ground is found at eye height), until the opponent is on screen again; then for a few ticks more it is brought onto the opponent, so that what is found is not lost again at once. The turn itself is AimRule's, which did the same only in the ticks after a hit.

Why it is a rule. The user, 18 October: when it loses its aim, above all with the opponent gone round behind it, "it doesn't know to spin 180 degrees to find my opponent", or it looks at the ground and spins. A network that sees only the screen has nothing on it to go by once the opponent has left it, and it had learned no search worth the name: in training the opponent is almost never off the screen for long.

Not thread-safe; one per fighter.
